mapper.select: SELECT FROM question_collection c WHERE c.owner_id=#{owner} AND c.id=#{id}

SELECT s.step_id,s.question_id,s.question_version_id AS version_id,v.title,v.version_number, q.status,q.current_version_id FROM question_collection_step s JOIN question_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.question_id=s.question_id AND v.id=s.question_version_id JOIN question q ON q.owner_id=s.owner_id AND q.id=s.question_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.collection_id=#{collectionId} AND s.version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY s.position_index
mapper.update: UPDATE question_collection SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}
